content:
The **NAR Repair Yard** is a location in the Cranberry Bog region of Appalachia.

A small repair yard owned by the New Appalachian Railroad, servicing Trains running east to west along the railway's Red Line.

The repair yard sits beside a set of railway tracks. The small location contains a switching tower, parking lot, and Quonset hut which acts as a workshop area. The hut contains an Armor Workbench, two Explosives Crates, and assorted junk and tools. There is also a locked Safe (Picklock 2) in the tower.

- Potential Vault-Tec Bobblehead - In the control tower, on a Filing Cabinet.
- Stealth Boy - On a cabinet in the middle of the Quonset hut, on the middle row.
- Potential Armor Plan - On a table opposite of an armor workbench.
- Potential Armor Mod - On a metal shelf to the left, near an Armor Workbench, on the bottom row.

The NAR Repair Yard appears in *Fallout 76*.
